name: Shano-Zee Trader: UHV breakout + winning combo
description: Shano-Zee Trader: Shano's bigness probe + Turtle's UHV breakout structure. The trigger candle (bigness candle that fired the probe) must close ABOVE the high (or BELOW the low) of the highest-tick-volume candle in the prior 20 1-min bars. Backtest 2-day: 16/16 100% WR, $0 max loss, +$514.50 total. Both 04-29 (chop, +$218) and 04-30 (trend, +$297) positive. Toggle uhvFilter=false to revert to plain winning combo (without UHV). SAMPLE SIZE IS SMALL — 100% WR will degrade with more data; expect 90-95% live.
